experiment: Share immutable cold metric series labels from Index through MetricBlockStore and the existing merged instant-scan caller.
retention_decision: Reject after both Mimir controls and all four original signal controls: no repeatable whole-stack CPU/RSS/query advantage is qualified. Mimir CPU and RSS gains do not reproduce in the second control, whose querier RSS rises in all three pairs. Loki RSS and Pyroscope results are mixed; Tempo RSS falls but two pairs have unequal query completions. Restore the preceding owned-label representation and default cold shared-label adapter. Preserve both Mimir observations and every original signal control, independent JSON/KBIX wire ledgers, full values/order/tenant/first-label behavior, immutable snapshots, query publication/deletion checks and snapshot lifetimes. Remove assertions that require the rejected pointer-sharing implementation.

validation.negative_control: Removing only MetricBlockStore shared-series forwarding fails both production ownership regressions; other 630 PromQL and metrics-service unit cases pass. Actual source restored before qualification.
validation.wire_golden: Fixed JSON and binary v2 shard ledger passes on both original index and candidate.

scope: No measured performance gain claimed. Local correctness checks are distinct from pending private-GCP performance qualification.
